essence: Decide whether clones fork or duplicate, and whether hard copies are linked or unlinked
Support per-property overrides at section or property level, with reset and visibility into which are overridden
Build live lists where adding an item propagates changes, with items organised and saved themselves
Save deltas to a JSONL file
Say whether setting an item emits an event automatically, or should
Maybe extend item into a bindable item
Explore syntax patterns for referencing and binding properties when cloning pages and templating
Make Field extend Property with its own set method and a field type such as text input or slider
Let clone take a POJO and assign to any property or field
